thread:
rishi: spotted a small but consistent uptick in funcall parse errors on the new int8-lite canary this morning. ops-bot: canary report: https://infradash/redwood/canaries/17287  failure-rate=1.9% baseline=0.1% :rotating_light:
mai: any recent prompt or tokenizer tweaks?
rishi: prompts and schemas unchanged. changes: switch to per-channel int8 + reduced activation scale, and we tightened streaming flush to 25ms to cut latency.
leah: sample dump:
```
ERROR: JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 1 (char 0)
RESPONSE_SNIPPET: "\u0000\"{\\\"action\\\":\\\"close_ticket\\\",...}"
```
leading NULs before the JSON in ~30% of failing cases.
mai: that smells like first-token drift or a framing issue in streaming. did the encoder mapping change for int8?
rishi: no mapping change. streaming frames do show more boundary splits after the flush shrink. small messages that finish quickly seem most affected.
leah: hypothesis: quant pushes some low-value token probs up-first, combined with tighter flush causing split so first visible token becomes controlchar. kv-cache could also replay prefixes that include those tokens.
ops-bot: alert meta: failure_mode=streaming-prefix-noise, model=albatross-liteq-int8-canary-17287, samples=62
mai: immediate actions I suggest:
- revert streaming flush to 40ms on canary pool (temp)
- add a cheap scrub to runtime: trim leading chars <= 0x1F before parse
- enable 0.5% token-level first-token histogram logging for the canary model
- run a 5k-sample kv on/off comparison for first-token distribution
rishi: +1. scrub should be safe and fast; make it configurable and opt-in for canary so we don't hide a true regression.
leah: I'll open a scrub PR with unit tests and a flag to keep raw logs for auditing. PR -> https://git.redwood/repo/pull/7480
mai: I'll queue the kv microbench and share results here. quick sanity: if kv amplifies, we need to gate kv reuse for quantized models until we fix the mapping.
ops-bot: scrub deploy started on canary (commit=f0e1d2) est=4m
rishi: timeline: rollback flush now, scrub in 10m, bench parallel. reconvene 10:30 PT to decide gating rule. thanks all :thumbsup:
